title: Sail Rumbera

services.name: Sail Rumbera
services.desc: We offer a 4 day/3 night “cruise and learn” charter in the San Juan Islands. We’ll meet you in either Anacortes or Friday Harbor and spend our days sailing to some truly stunning spots. You’ll learn about sailing, motoring, route planning, navigation, anchoring, and using onboard systems. We’ll also make time for hikes, kayaking, and exploring by dinghy. All that, and some of Captain Scott’s favorite spots gleaned from over 27 years sailing in the San Juan and Gulf Islands. We limit this opportunity to 2 people because (1) the “immersion” into cruising is better if we keep numbers smaller, and (2) boats are small spaces.
